title: GAN
core_mech: 生成器与判别器通过同一 value function 对抗优化，以数据驱动判别器替代固定重建损失。
core_mech_en: Generator and discriminator networks engage in a two-player minimax game, replacing hand-crafted pixel reconstruction losses with a learned adversarial critic.
input_desc: 先验噪声 z 与真实数据样本 x
input_en: Latent noise vector z ~ p_z(z) and real data samples x ~ p_data(x)
output_desc: 逼近真实数据分布的生成样本
output_en: Synthesized samples G(z) approximating the real data distribution

source.title: GAN
notes: Original author's GAN research implementation; dependency versions and training recipe differ from modern teaching code.

adapter.name: GAN
adapter.mechanism: Separate discriminator and non-saturating generator gradients implement the two-player game.
limitations: Small MLP generator/discriminator; one simultaneous update instead of a tuned adversarial training schedule.
Synthetic teaching data only; no clinical validity or published benchmark is claimed.
